exposure: timing of maternal COVID-19 infection (first, second, third trimester)
cohort: The study included 19,050 women-offspring dyads who delivered at the Soroka University Medical Center between December 30, 2020, and July 30, 2022.
finding: Offspring exposed to maternal COVID-19 infection, particularly in the late third trimester, were at increased risk for viral and COVID-19 infections up to the age of 1 year, while exposure earlier in gestation was associated with a lower risk for these infections.
